title: The Aboriginal Genocide in Australia
subtitle: 1788 to the present — Frontier Wars, Stolen Generations, ongoing avoidable death
abstract: An interactive data anarchive of the ongoing Aboriginal Genocide in Australia — from the 1788 invasion and the 19th-century Frontier Wars, through the Stolen Generations (100,000 children forcibly removed), to today's ~4,000 avoidable Indigenous deaths per year and the 11.5-year life-expectancy gap. Includes population-collapse visualization (350k–1M → 100k → 670k), a chronological timeline, the UN Genocide Convention framework with all five acts marked as applying, a side-by-side comparison with the Palestinian Genocide, and period quotes from the perpetrators. Figures are Dr. Gideon Polya's documented avoidable-mortality estimates, presented faithfully with full attribution.
